source.protocol: Reuse existing current flow/session and stage142 WeChat adapter. No new binary queries or protocol fields.
source.reused_local_policy: Existing shared XML game/region/Galaxy ordinal selection, four-page launcher-local review and explicitly configured ascii/windows-936/utf-8 credential/name codecs. Local review policy is not a fresh claim of current native terms equivalence.

host.configuration: Explicit local JS-text XML pair, sourceProfile win32-current, textEncoding ascii/windows-936/utf-8, boolean bare-amp policy,1..10 allowed endpoints and four provided text pages. Empty default is valid unconfigured state with no IO. No credentials in config.
host.selection: Explicit game/region/Galaxy ordinals, existing availability/duplicate/closed gates; chosen endpoints must all match allowlist and stage142 TCP profile.
host.review: Reuse four-page review with forcePrompt true and no persistence; credential/target change invalidates confirmation. No invented or auto-accepted official terms.
host.privacy: Credentials stay private in the controller, never in view/setData/log/storage; input remount resets native widgets after submission/cancel/hide. Byte copies cleared after session construction.
host.lifecycle: Page/App hide and unload cancel session, clear input/review/results and ignore late promise results via generation ownership.
host.labels: Protocol raw byte names use the explicit configured existing codec and strict roundtrip validation, otherwise a neutral numbered fallback; no guessed Windows codepage or character identity.
host.build: New local build/wechat-app project with standalone CommonJS logic and original App/Page/WXML/WXSS; explicit optional config; existing standalone module output unchanged.

validation: Empty/default config makes no TCP/entropy calls
Actual host normal/wrong-group exchange with existing independent original Python peer via Node-backed wx facade
Hide/unload/cancel clears credentials, ignores late replies and releases owned sockets
Build generated host and run public CLI/automation only if normal current settings permit; no security/configuration bypass, production upload or foreign AppID
remaining: Original game business consumers and verified playable implementation
